meta.title: Hold Da Bass Up
meta.author: MaV
meta.description: The soundtrack of Hold Da Bass Up by MaV (2026-06-13). 32K executable music that won the 32K executable music competition at Nova 2026. 139 BPM, 4:08, 22 tracks, 7101 notes. Instruments: 6 Falcon (FM synth), 8 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 4 Thunder (GSM sample player), 1 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 8 Scissor, 7 Leveller, 2 Crusher, 12 Echo, 15 Smasher, 1 Chamber. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.19 dB loudness and at most 0.68 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
